senses.gloss:
Ghāsa means ‘fodder’ in the Atharvaveda and later. In the Rigveda Ghāsi is used of the fodder of the horse victim at the aśvamedha.
Foot notes Av. iv. 38, 7; viii. 7, 8; xi. 5, 18, etc.
Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xi. 75; xxi. 43; taittirīya Saṃhitā, vi. 5, 9, 3; taittirīya brāhmaṇa, i. 6, 3, 10, etc.
i. 162, 14.
